programs.title: Medical Frontiers
programs.desc: . Biologic drugs, made mainly from antibodies, have transformed the approach to treating chronic inflammatory diseases such as asthma and rheumatoid arthritis. We explore their mechanisms and potential. Erica Angyal, Maxwell Powers.

programs.title: The Factory Wonders
programs.desc: . Our team visits a heat-resistant glass factory in Koga, Ibaraki Pref., to witness the skills of the glassblowers and lampworkers, and learn about the secrets that heat-resistant glass holds.

programs.title: Time-lapse Japan

programs.title: Hometown Stories
programs.desc: , Episode 14, Season 14. With colorful pile fabric and comfortable knits, Wakayama prefecture is drawing global attention as a textile hub. We bring you striking images of its machines and the beat of its factories. Soness Stevens, Hiroyuki Hamada, Koji Okubo, Yusuke Ito.

programs.title: Satoyama Kitchen Diary
programs.desc: . At the Satoyama Kitchen guesthouse in Hida Takayama, chef Nobuko, her cameraman husband Makoto and their cat Tama take us on a tasty journey of local cuisine served with a side of seasonal scenery.

programs.title: On the Wings
programs.desc: , Episode 3. Join us on a night flight to admire Japan's stunning views on a journey from Tokyo to Fukuoka. Behold the sublime beauty of Mt. Fuji at sunset and the sparkling night views of major cities.

programs.title: Sumopedia
programs.desc: . Sumopedia enriches your sumo experience with insights into the sport’s techniques, traditions and legendary wrestlers. While the rules are simple, this iconic Japanese sport has far more depth than meets the eye.

programs.desc: . The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture. This episode looks at words related to the number eight. Explore the unique culture behind them.
